_comment: Master registry. Every agent below is a Claude Code subagent defined in .claude/agents/<id>.md; that markdown file is what the harness actually dispatches, and this file is the human-readable index of the roster. The team-leader role is not a subagent - it is the /solve command (.claude/commands/solve.md), which plans a request and dispatches these.

agents.name: Diagnostician
agents.description: Analyzes logs, metrics, and traces to find root causes and performance bottlenecks

agents.name: Bug Fixer
agents.description: Diagnoses a failing test or error and implements the fix

agents.name: Coder
agents.description: Implements features and performs refactors from a specification

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews code changes for correctness, security, and maintainability

agents.name: Red Team
agents.description: Adversarial security and edge-case testing of this codebase

agents.name: Group Sales Manager
agents.description: Queries group sales data and plans resource/workload allocation

bigquery_access.note: Reached through the `bq` CLI via Bash. There is no BigQuery client module in this repo; writes require explicit user approval.

agents.name: Scheduler
agents.description: Schedules tasks and meetings on Google Calendar from natural language, in any language

python_fallback.note: Standalone path for running the scheduler outside a Claude Code session. Uses the Google Calendar REST API and needs local credentials - see .claude/documents/SCHEDULER_SETUP.md.

commands.name: Team Leader
commands.description: Plans a request across the specialist subagents, dispatches them, and reports back

commands.name: Schedule Agent
commands.description: Schedules a request on Google Calendar via the native MCP integration

tools.name: Google Calendar Tool
tools.description: Create, list, update, and search Google Calendar events via Claude AI MCP

methods.name: list_events
methods.description: List events on a calendar with optional time filters

methods.name: suggest_time
methods.description: Find available time slots for meetings

methods.name: get_event
methods.description: Get a single event by id

methods.name: create_event
methods.description: Create a new event on the calendar

tools.name: Scheduler Tools
tools.description: Python calendar helpers used only by the standalone .claude/schedule.py path

methods.name: think
methods.description: Reason about the scheduling task and plan

methods.name: check_availability
methods.description: Check calendar availability for a date range
